Whether the 1.2 GW Texas Bring-Your-Own-Power project reaches a signed FID on the disclosed capacity-payment structure - it is the only leg

Whether the 1.2 GW Texas Bring-Your-Own-Power project reaches a signed FID on the disclosed capacity-payment structure - it is the only leg that replaces a merchant ERCOT price assumption (the 2026 plan embeds $52/MWh Houston around-the-clock against $33 realised in Q2) with a hyperscaler capacity payment, and it is explicitly pre-decision today.
